preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**9 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Each N in the test cases is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, int) for value in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(value == max_value(N) for value, N in zip(output, Ns))
postconditions.description: Each output value is the maximum possible value of the permutation for the corresponding N.
